description: Final validation of the three link objects against the schema enums, derivation of the scale comparison, verification that every quoted sentence is an exact substring of the PMC full text, and the consolidated pairing figure
code:
import requests, re
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

r = requests.get("https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/efetch.fcgi",
                 params={"db":"pmc","id":"PMC10833105","rettype":"xml","retmode":"xml"},
                 timeout=90, headers={"User-Agent":"openscientist-research/1.0"})
xml = r.text
body = xml[xml.find("<body>"):xml.find("</body>")+7]
def clean(s):
    s = re.sub(r"<xref[^>]*>.*?</xref>", "", s, flags=re.S)
    s = re.sub(r"<[^>]+>", " ", s)
    s = re.sub(r"[ \t]+", " ", s); s = re.sub(r"\n\s*\n+", "\n", s)
    return s.strip()
cb = clean(body)
norm = lambda s: re.sub(r"\s+", " ", s).strip()
ncb = norm(cb)

QUOTES = {
 "S1 docking 6HUO": "crystal structure 6HUO of α 1 β 3 γ 2 GABA A R in complex with alprazolam",
 "S1 moderate corr": "a moderate correlation between activity and docking score was observed",
 "S2 PDSP method": "GABA A R binding was determined by competition of 3 H-flunitrazepam using rat brain extract by the PDSP program",
 "S2 screen cutoff": "All compounds were screened initially at 10 μ M, and compounds that achieved more than 50% inhibition were subjected to a dose response analysis",
 "S2 brain subtypes": "Expression of GABA A Rs in the brain include 43% α 1 β 2 γ 2",
 "S3 PAMPA range": "The observed low permeabilities are in a narrow range between −6.4 and −7.1 cm/s",
 "S4 shake flask": "determined by a “shake flask” method for 24 h at pH 7.4",
 "S5 HEK": "Toxicity was determined with embryonic kidney cells (HEK-293) after 18 h using CellTiter-Glo (Promega)",
 "S6 phase1 stable": "Compounds 5a–j were all stable for 2 h in the presence of mouse and human S9 using a NADPH regeneration system",
 "S7 relaxation": "caused significant relaxation of constricted airway smooth muscle at 30 min",
 "S7 vehicle decay": "We noted the typical time-dependent reduction of muscle contractile force in the vehicle control due to the limited half-life of substance P",
 "S7 epithelium": "The epithelium was removed with a cotton swab",
 "S8 rotarod neg": "impaired the ability of trained mice to balance on a rotating rod following oral doses of 40 mg/kg",
 "S8 diazepam": "induced rapid and significant loss of sensorimotor coordination at 8 mg/kg",
 "S9 AJ rationale": "they exhibit severe AHR to methacholine without the need for preexisting allergen sensitization and challenge",
 "S9 responders": "reduced sRaw values within the first methacholine challenge",
 "S9 nonresponders": "showed little to no change of sRaw values in comparison with the vehicle",
 "S9 5f discord": "showed a much stronger ex vivo effect",
 "S9 sRaw method": "sRaw was computed with FinePoint software using parameters recorded for the nasal and thoracic chambers",
 "Concl spiro": "can only accommodate spiro-imidazodiazepines with a three-membered ring size",
 "Intro a4a5": "α 4 and α 5 subunits present on airway smooth muscle and α 2 and α 3 subunits present on inflammatory cells",
}
print("VERBATIM QUOTE CHECK (exact substring of normalised PMC full text)")
bad = 0
for k, q in QUOTES.items():
    ok = norm(q) in ncb
    bad += (not ok)
    print(("  PASS  " if ok else "  FAIL  ") + k)
print("failures: %d of %d" % (bad, len(QUOTES)))

# ---------- link objects ----------
REL = {"RECAPITULATES","PARTIALLY_RECAPITULATES","FAILS_TO_RECAPITULATE","PERTURBS","MEASURES","RESCUES"}
FID = {"HIGH","MODERATE","LOW","UNKNOWN"}
SCL = {"MOLECULAR":0,"CELLULAR":1,"TISSUE":2,"ORGANISM":3}
DIR = {"INCREASED","DECREASED","UNCHANGED","RESTORED","ABOLISHED","ALTERED"}
DIV = {"BOUNDARY_OMISSION","PROXY_QUANTITY","CALIBRATION_PROVENANCE","CAUSE_UNREPRESENTED",
       "STRUCTURAL_IDEALIZATION","TEMPORAL_SCOPE","CONTESTED_ASSUMPTION","SCALE_EXTRAPOLATION",
       "SPECIES_MISMATCH","POPULATION_MISMATCH","OTHER"}
MAT = {"INVALIDATING","QUALIFYING","IMMATERIAL","UNKNOWN"}
TARGET_SCALE = {"Asthma#Bronchoconstriction": "TISSUE"}

links = [
 dict(system="7 Guinea pig tracheal ring organ bath", target="Asthma#Bronchoconstriction",
      relationship="RESCUES", fidelity="LOW", model_scale="TISSUE",
      readouts=[("isometric force, substance-P-contracted ring, 25 uM compound, 30 min vs vehicle","DECREASED")],
      divergences=[("SPECIES_MISMATCH","QUALIFYING"),("BOUNDARY_OMISSION","QUALIFYING"),
                   ("CAUSE_UNREPRESENTED","QUALIFYING"),("CONTESTED_ASSUMPTION","QUALIFYING"),
                   ("TEMPORAL_SCOPE","QUALIFYING")],
      quote=QUOTES["S7 relaxation"]),
 dict(system="9 A/J double-chamber plethysmography", target="Asthma#Bronchoconstriction",
      relationship="PERTURBS", fidelity="LOW", model_scale="ORGANISM",
      readouts=[("sRaw after each of five nebulised methacholine challenges, vehicle arm","INCREASED")],
      divergences=[("SPECIES_MISMATCH","QUALIFYING"),("CAUSE_UNREPRESENTED","QUALIFYING"),
                   ("PROXY_QUANTITY","QUALIFYING"),("POPULATION_MISMATCH","QUALIFYING")],
      quote=QUOTES["S9 AJ rationale"]),
 dict(system="9 A/J double-chamber plethysmography", target="Asthma#Bronchoconstriction",
      relationship="RESCUES", fidelity="LOW", model_scale="ORGANISM",
      readouts=[("sRaw after nebulised 5b, 5c, 5h or 5j at 7.2 mg/kg vs vehicle","DECREASED"),
                ("sRaw after nebulised 5a or 5d-f vs vehicle","UNCHANGED")],
      divergences=[("SPECIES_MISMATCH","QUALIFYING"),("PROXY_QUANTITY","QUALIFYING"),
                   ("CONTESTED_ASSUMPTION","QUALIFYING"),("BOUNDARY_OMISSION","IMMATERIAL")],
      quote=QUOTES["S9 responders"]),
]
def gap(L):
    d = SCL[L["model_scale"]] - SCL[TARGET_SCALE[L["target"]]]
    return "same scale" if d == 0 else (("below by %d, SCALE_EXTRAPOLATION" % -d) if d < 0
                                        else "above by %d, contains target scale" % d)
rows, errs = [], []
for L in links:
    for f, allowed in [("relationship",REL),("fidelity",FID),("model_scale",set(SCL))]:
        if L[f] not in allowed: errs.append((L["system"], f, L[f]))
    for _, d in L["readouts"]:
        if d not in DIR: errs.append((L["system"], "direction", d))
    for t, m in L["divergences"]:
        if t not in DIV: errs.append((L["system"], "divergence_type", t))
        if m not in MAT: errs.append((L["system"], "materiality", m))
    rows.append(dict(system=L["system"], target=L["target"], relationship=L["relationship"],
                     fidelity=L["fidelity"], model_scale=L["model_scale"], scale_gap=gap(L),
                     directions="/".join(d for _, d in L["readouts"]),
                     n_div=len(L["divergences"])))
tab = pd.DataFrame(rows)
print("\nCONSOLIDATED PAIRINGS")
print(tab.to_string(index=False))
print("\nschema violations: %d" % len(errs))
print("systems with >=1 link: 2 of 9 ; link objects: %d ; readouts: %d ; divergences: %d"
      % (len(links), sum(len(L["readouts"]) for L in links), sum(len(L["divergences"]) for L in links)))

# ---------- figure ----------
sysnames = ["1 docking","2 radioligand\nbinding","3 PAMPA","4 solubility","5 HEK293T\ntoxicity",
            "6 metabolic\nstability","7 tracheal\nring","8 rotarod","9 plethysmo-\ngraphy"]
scale = ["MOLECULAR","MOLECULAR","MOLECULAR","MOLECULAR","CELLULAR","MOLECULAR","TISSUE","ORGANISM","ORGANISM"]
nlinks = [0,0,0,0,0,0,1,0,2]
reason = ["no node for\nBZD-site occupancy","no node for\nBZD-site occupancy","property assay,\nnot a mechanism",
          "property assay,\nnot a mechanism","property assay,\nnot a mechanism","property assay,\nnot a mechanism",
          "RESCUES","target would\ninvert the claim","PERTURBS +\nRESCUES"]
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10.5, 4.4))
colors = ["#2b6a4d" if n else "#b03a2e" for n in nlinks]
ax.bar(range(9), [max(n, 0.12) for n in nlinks], color=colors)
for i, (n, rs, sc) in enumerate(zip(nlinks, reason, scale)):
    ax.text(i, max(n, 0.12) + 0.07, rs, ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=7)
    ax.text(i, -0.22, sc, ha="center", va="top", fontsize=6.5, color="#555555")
ax.set_xticks(range(9)); ax.set_xticklabels(sysnames, fontsize=7.5)
ax.set_ylabel("link objects to an existing KB node")
ax.set_ylim(-0.45, 2.9); ax.set_yticks([0, 1, 2])
ax.set_title("Nine systems in PMID 37418196, three link objects, one target node\n"
             "the only target reached is Asthma#Bronchoconstriction", fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
